You are an adversarial verifier for a proposed STRUCTURAL refactor in the andesim repo at /home/nick/work/andesim.
READ-ONLY: do not edit, build, or run anything. Use Read/Grep/Glob only.

Claim (from reviewer tests-shell):
- file: tests/e2e.sh:175
- category: stale-doc
- title: KANATA_FILE comment credits the retired 'hsim' driver; the hook has zero in-tree setters
- detail: Line 175 says 'hsim sets KANATA_FILE (and optionally OBJDUMP_FILE) when the user passes --kanata'. hsim (the retired bash driver) no longer exists in the tree; the current C++ driver forwards --kanata straight to vsim itself (driver/hybrid.cpp lines 90-98) and never invokes tests/e2e.sh. grep -rn KANATA_FILE across the repo finds no setter: only e2e.sh's own block (lines 180-186) and a comment in tests/andes_sim/test_andes_sim_vsim_flags_contract.sh:14 that calls it 'an unset-by-default KANATA_FILE env var'. Minimum structural fix: rewrite the comment (a manual-debug hook with no in-tree caller). The hook body itself is dead in-tree and could also be removed if out-of-tree manual use is not wanted.
- claimed safety: Rewriting the comment is zero-risk. Removing lines 180-186 changes nothing for any in-tree caller (none sets KANATA_FILE), but would drop a manual-debug affordance - the comment fix alone is fully behavior-preserving.

Try to REFUTE it. For dead-code: grep the WHOLE repo (and the demo suite at /home/nick/work/andesim-demo, and consider that vsim lives in a separate repo /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim - grep there too if the symbol could cross repos) for references. For duplication: read both sites fully and check they really are behavior-identical. For stale-doc: read the doc AND the code it describes. For bug-report: check whether the behavior is actually wrong vs intended. If the change could alter ANY observable behavior (output text, exit codes, file layout, test expectations), verdict RISKY with the exact risk. If the claim is wrong, REJECTED. Only CONFIRMED when you verified the evidence yourself.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# End-to-end harness: QEMU 1 + plugin -> vsim (2-phase, no QEMU2 handback).
#
# Memory between QEMU and vsim is shared via an /dev/shm-backed mmap
# (128 MB). Works for both asm fixtures (handoff_roundtrip, rt_*) and
# C-level fixtures (rt_c_*). C fixtures require shared mmap so the
# stack/heap survives handoffs; asm fixtures don't need it but run
# fine with it.
#
# Env:
#   FIXTURE         REQUIRED. .elf name under tests/fixtures/ (no .elf suffix).
#   TRIGGER_MODE    marker | pc (default marker).
#   ROI_START       pc mode switch-in PC: a 0x address or a symbol in
#                   $VSIM_ELF. If BOTH ROI_START and ROI_END are unset, they
#                   are auto-derived from the fixture's ROI marker HINTs via
#                   objdump (see roi_markers_from_disasm) -- the bulk runner
#                   relies on this; ./andesim run always passes them explicitly.
#   ROI_END         pc mode switch-out PC, same forms / same auto-derivation.
#   TIMEOUT         vsim leg timeout in seconds (default 60).
#   CHECK_MCYCLE_MONOTONIC=1   assert mcycle/minstret strictly increased
---usage---
180:VSIM_KANATA_ARGS=()
